notes: Security queue empty; IDEAS.md and website requests empty; routed ventures/2 by draw; allocate.py picked row 7 quick-pick-survey. Built scripts/answer-time-sweep.ts (171 cells, simulated timing with assumptions swept: careless pace ratio 1/0.6/0.4, honest slowing on close pairs gamma 0/0.6, person pace spread 0.4/0.6, panels 20/60). Pace never separates a camp from the majority (AUC 0.50-0.56) and separates careless people as far as they are quicker (0.83-0.98); slope confuses camps like agreement. Shipped respondentPace/fastAnswerers/paceSummary/parseDrop in groupRanking.ts, `pace` in the ranking route, builder and report, and ?drop=fast (opt-in comparison; default ranking unchanged). Verified locally: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm test (52 files, 428 tests), npm run build, ranking integration test against live Postgres via scripts/test-db.sh (6 passed, incl. the new drop=fast test), mutation check on FAST_PACE boundary. Timing model is invented: no real msToAnswer data from this product exists; that is the next item in flagships.yaml.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
